meta.source: MA DOR Division of Local Services, Municipal Databank, 'Tax Levies by Class' report (data current as of 11/08/2026)
meta.method: All 352 entries, fiscal years 2014-2027, read from the report in the browser (mass.gov and the DLS gateway refuse scripted requests, so this file is refreshed by hand, not by CI). Statewide total = sum of the 'Total Levy' column over the 351 cities and towns (DOR codes 001-351). Devens (code 840) is a regional enterprise zone, not a municipality, and is excluded; it would add $18.3M (0.08%) in FY2026.
meta.check: Every year FY2014-FY2026 has a Total Levy for all 351 municipalities, and the per-class columns (residential, open space, commercial, industrial, personal property) sum to the total within $30 in every year.

currency.why_not_newer: FY2027 tax rates are set town by town through the winter; on 2026-11-08 only 37 of 351 municipalities had an FY2027 levy in the Databank, so FY2027 is not a statewide total yet. Refresh once all 351 report (normally by late spring).
